newsitem.title: UK: Council of Europe FFR Eurobond seen for 10 years.
newsitem.headline: Council of Europe FFR Eurobond seen for 10 years.

text.p: The Council of Europe Development Fund's forthcoming French franc Eurobond is expected to be for 3.0 billion francs with a 10-year maturity, bankers said on Monday.
Earlier, the Council of Europe mandated J.P. Morgan and Societe Generale to lead manage the transaction. Officials there declined to comment on terms of the deal.
Syndicate managers elsewhere said the bond was expected to be launched on Wednesday. Spread talk covered a wide range, between nine and 13 basis points over OATs.
"There is no official spread talk yet and the market indications are quite varied at the moment," a Paris-based syndicate manager said.
The bond will have a clause allowing for redenomination into euros once EMU is introduced.
